BiblicalUsage: Salmâh is how the Bible says a dress. It stands in 1 Kings 10:25, "…brought every man his present, vessels of silver…", and in 2 Chronicles 9:24, "…brought every man his present, vessels of silver…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe salmâh is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
